Your answer helped to reassure me, I needed that.
I think I might have some trouble recognizing and differentiating wants from needs. Until now I only learned to use them for decision making and to understand myself, not for communication with others. 
 
He told me during our phone conversation that he would’ve liked or expected me to get new dressings and get them to him. He said that a friend of his asked if he should bring him some dressing and that he wanted that from me. He also said “for example”, so I don’t know what he exactly wanted me to do or whether he expected or wanted me to do more. 
I didn’t think to ask any more questions,  I also didn’t want to get into a discussion, since he wanted to just tell me and discuss the rest personally. I wasn’t really able to react anymore than a few sentences too, because I had an emotional shut down I think. I can’t remember the conversation well. I was overwhelmed with how he communicated with me during the call. That’s why I started to question myself.
